block.createhp.pressure_valve.tooltip.su: Closes a pipe _completely_: no fluid and no _pressure_ gets past it. Holds up to _256 bar_.
block.createhp.pressure_valve.tooltip.be: Opens, like Create's _Fluid Valve_. Without rotation it closes.
Makes it _smart_: it then opens while _powered by redstone_ and needs no shaft.
Closes a pipe _completely_: no fluid and no _pressure_ gets past it. Holds up to _1,024 bar_.
Opens, like Create's _Fluid Valve_. Without rotation it closes.
Makes it _smart_: it then opens while _powered by redstone_ and needs no shaft.
block.createhp.pressure_regulator.toolti: Caps the _pressure_ behind it at a set value and so _lowers the flow_. Holds up to _256 bar_.
Sets the _pressure_ let through, up to the valve's limit.
Makes it _smart_: _redstone strength_ 0 to 15 sets the value, 15 is the valve's limit.
block.createhp.netherite_pressure_regula: Caps the _pressure_ behind it at a set value and so _lowers the flow_. Holds up to _1,024 bar_.
Sets the _pressure_ let through, up to the valve's limit.
Makes it _smart_: _redstone strength_ 0 to 15 sets the value, 15 is the valve's limit.
block.createhp.relief_valve.tooltip.summ: Keeps its whole pipe run at or below a set _pressure_. Anything above is _vented_ as a cloud and the fluid is lost. Holds up to _256 bar_.
block.createhp.relief_valve.tooltip.beha: Sets the _relief pressure_. Starts at the valve's own limit.
Makes it _smart_: it _emits redstone_ while venting.
block.createhp.netherite_relief_valve.to: Keeps its whole pipe run at or below a set _pressure_. Anything above is _vented_ as a cloud and the fluid is lost. Holds up to _1,024 bar_.
Sets the _relief pressure_. Starts at the valve's own limit.
Makes it _smart_: it _emits redstone_ while venting.
block.createhp.pressure_tank.tooltip.sum: A _Fluid Tank_ that holds _32 buckets_ per block and up to _256 bar_. Connects into large tanks and works as a _boiler_ like Create's tank.
block.createhp.pressure_tank.tooltip.beh: The block at that connection _cracks and bursts_, and its share of the content is lost.
block.createhp.netherite_pressure_tank.t: A _Fluid Tank_ that holds _128 buckets_ per block and up to _1,024 bar_. Connects into large tanks and works as a _boiler_ like Create's tank.
block.createhp.steam_outlet.tooltip.summ: Attach it to a _boiler_ like a _Steam Engine_. The boiler's spare _levels_ become _steam_, 10 mB per tick per level, which _pumps_ draw from the front.
block.createhp.steam_outlet.tooltip.beha: Pressure tanks boil up to _50 levels_ (copper) or _150 levels_ (netherite) and can be _5×5_ wide.
createhp.gui.goggles.turbine_too_long: Too long: at most %1$s rotor layers
createhp.gui.goggles.inlet_buffer: %1$s of %2$s mB steam in the inlet
createhp.gui.goggles.turbine_unlinked: Not part of a complete turbine
block.createhp.turbine_casing.tooltip.su: Shell of a _Steam Turbine_: the _5×5_ walls at both ends and a ring of _16_ around every rotor layer.
Shell of a _Netherite Steam Turbine_: the _5×5_ walls at both ends and a ring of _16_ around every rotor layer.
block.createhp.turbine_rotor.tooltip.sum: The _3×3_ core of every layer of a _Steam Turbine_. Each layer takes up to _100 mB_ of steam per tick.
block.createhp.netherite_turbine_rotor.t: The _3×3_ core of every layer of a _Netherite Steam Turbine_. Each layer takes up to _200 mB_ of steam per tick.
block.createhp.steam_inlet.tooltip.summa: Takes the place of a casing block and takes _steam_ from pipes on any side. Holds up to _256 bar_.
block.createhp.netherite_steam_inlet.too: Takes the place of a netherite casing block and takes _steam_ from pipes on any side. Holds up to _1,024 bar_.
block.createhp.condensate_outlet.tooltip: Takes the place of a casing block. _Half_ of the steam comes out here as _water_ for pumps to draw, so a _boiler_ can be fed in a loop. Fits copper and netherite turbines.
block.createhp.turbine_output.tooltip.su: Goes in the middle of the front wall of a _Steam Turbine_, shaft facing out. Checks the turbine behind it and turns at _64 RPM_ while steam flows.
block.createhp.turbine_output.tooltip.co: Per 10 mB of steam per tick
block.createhp.turbine_output.tooltip.be: Delivers _1.5 times_ (copper) or _2.5 times_ (netherite) the power of a _Steam Engine_ at full load.
